'''Ronto steaks''' were a cut of [[Steak/Legends|steak]] taken from a [[Ronto/Legends|ronto]]. When he was a [[Youngling/Legends|child]], the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Doda Bodonawieedo/Legends|Doda Bodonawieedo]] stole ronto steaks as he grew up on the streets of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].<ref name="CCG-Dodo" />
